digest.component_or_area: CI/CD pipeline, Gerrit verification workflow, GitHub Actions
propositions: Ubuntu Verified jobs occupy 30.2 runner-minutes per run with individual phases exceeding 30 seconds caused by redundant YAML parsing in bridge_cadence test (1440 iterations), repeated Pandoc subprocess invocations in render_corpus/render_hardening, and AST provenance fixture setup overhead.
Hoisting invariant YAML schedule loading from the 1440-iteration loop eliminates 342.22s repeated parse cost without changing test assertions or coverage; consensus-backed and merged via Gerrit 1756.

Replacing legacy Pandoc subprocess side in render_hardening with immutable expected outputs while retaining 884 real product conversions eliminates 883 redundant subprocesses; consensus-backed and merged via Gerrit 1773.

Complexity-lock policy invocation moved from inside pytest matrix cells to external lint job eliminates ~154 runner-seconds per Verified run by removing quadruplicate evaluation of OS/Python-invariant static policy.

Post-remediation full-route steady-state occupancy reduced from 34m26s baseline to 21m28s (current run 31883105646), freeing 436.79s=7m17s per Verified run and 21.1% Ubuntu occupancy reduction while preserving all assertions, cells, selectors, and coverage.

Stale-run same-change workflow-concurrency serialization (25m13s delays) eliminated via Gerrit 1792 by replacing job-level always() predicates with !cancelled() to respect GitHub cancellation while preserving classifier-failure fallback.
